tools.name: read_pdf
tools.description: Reads content/metadata/images from one or more PDFs (local/URL). Each source can specify pages to extract.

path.description: Path to the local PDF file (absolute or relative to cwd).

include_full_text.description: Include the full text content of each PDF (only if 'pages' is not specified for that source).

include_metadata.description: Include metadata and info objects for each PDF.

include_page_count.description: Include the total number of pages for each PDF.

include_images.description: Extract and include embedded images from the PDF pages as base64-encoded data.

include_tables.description: Detect and extract tables from PDF pages. Uses spatial clustering of text coordinates to identify tabular structures.
